recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: Lost every passkey? Two of your friend+ friends can get you back in.
recover.step1: Meet one of your friend+ friends. On their phone they open Settings → Recovery and start a recovery for you.
recover.step2: Scan the code on their screen with this device, check the 6-digit code with them and play the sound.
recover.step3: A second friend+ friend approves. After 24 hours, during which your signed-in devices can still cancel, you create a new passkey here.
recover.scanHint: Point the camera at the code on your friend's screen.
recover.unknown: This device has no recovery in progress.

state.claimed: Finish the check with your friend: the codes must match and the sound must play.
state.approving: Your friend vouched for you. Now a second friend+ friend has to approve the recovery in their settings.
state.holding: Approved. You can create a new passkey from {at}. Until then your signed-in devices can cancel it. Keep this page or come back later on this device.
state.released: Your recovery is ready. Every old session has been signed out.

approve.title: Waiting for your approval
approve.none: No friend needs your approval right now.
approve.item: {name} is recovering their account. Another friend+ friend checked it was them in person. Approve by {at}.
approve.warning: Only approve if you know they really lost their passkeys: the recovery gives a new device full access to their account.
approve.done: Approved. Their account is told and can cancel for 24 hours.

help.title: Help a friend recover
help.intro: Only for a friend+ friend who is with you in person and has lost every passkey. A second friend+ friend of theirs must approve afterwards.
help.none: You have no friend+ friends yet.
help.scan: Let {handle} scan this code with their device.

errors.recovery_exists: A recovery of this account is already under way.
errors.second_guardian_required: A different friend+ friend has to approve this recovery.
errors.recovery_expired: This recovery waited too long for approval and has expired.
